SELECT
    SUM(realline) AS total_realized_pnl,
    AVG(realline) AS avg_realized_pnl,
    (SUM(realline) / SUM(walletsum)) AS profit_ratio
FROM
    accountbalances;
```

This query calculates the total realized profit and loss (`total_realized_pnl`), the average realized profit and loss (`avg_realized_pnl`), and the profit ratio (`profit_ratio`) by dividing the total realized profit and loss by the total wallet sum from the `accountbalances` table. The results are presented in a single row with the specified column names.
